validate_task_spec.goal: The auth package can tell whether a token has expired.
acceptance_criteria: Add a Clock interface with a Now() time.Time method, and a SystemClock type implementing it with time.Now().
Expired(tok Token, c Clock) returns true when tok.ExpiresAt is before c.Now(), and false otherwise.
validate_task_spec.context: Token is the struct in token.go; ExpiresAt is a time.Time.

validate_completion.summary: Clock interface and SystemClock as the ACs ask; Expired compares ExpiresAt with the clock.
validate_completion.test_evidence:
=== RUN   TestExpired
--- PASS: TestExpired (0.00s)
PASS
ok  	example.com/app/internal/auth	0.003s
validate_completion.final_diff:
diff --git a/internal/auth/clock.go b/internal/auth/clock.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2eab3e3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/auth/clock.go
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+package auth
+
+import "time"
+
+type Clock interface {
+	Now() time.Time
+}
+
+type SystemClock struct{}
+
+func (SystemClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now() }
+
+func Expired(tok Token, c Clock) bool {
+	return tok.ExpiresAt.Before(c.Now())
+}
